The '''monzu''' was a type of spotted creature that could be found on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zolan/Legends|Zolan]]. They were capable of flashing their backs in pulsating rainbow patterns, an ability similar to the [[Changeling/Legends|changeling]] traits of Zolan's [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] population.<ref name="SWG10" />

==Behind the scenes==
Monzu were mentioned in "[[The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Clawdites]]," an article published in the [[Star Wars Gamer 10|tenth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Gamer]]'' magazine<ref name="SWG10">{{GamerCite|10|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Clawdites}}</ref> on [[May 7]], [[2002]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=gaming/other/rpg/news20020416.html|text=Episode II in Gamer #10}}</ref>
